verdict.rationale: Framer documents automatic version history with restore of any earlier version, plus branching to isolate changes before merging — covering restore and a form of comparison via branch review. However, there's no evidence of named milestones/checkpoints or a dedicated diff/compare view between versions, only 'restore in seconds.' missing for 10: ability to name/label milestones, an explicit compare/diff UI between versions, and independent hands-on confirmation of restore reliability.
